decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: Exact native original and actual returned raw-master alpha comparison inspected. The original has a broad visible smiling mouth with a clear light strip of teeth and relaxed/lifted mouth corners. The return loses that expression into a small closed stern mouth with no visible smile. Restore the actual source smile, small visible teeth strip and cheek/brow expression directly from image2. Do not invent a huge grin, facial hair or change source pose. Preserve unrelated actual dark combed hair, smooth facial-hair state, blue uniform/jacket, real pale oval lapel fittings, white shirt/dark tie, pose/lighting/crop, compact broad collar fit and intact opaque photo/card interior with true exterior alpha.
